learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the concepts of integrity and durability of structures with defects and cracks, define fracture mechanics parameters, and apply fracture mechanics criteria.

Determine analytically, numerically using specialized software, and experimentally the parameters of fracture mechanics, and become familiar with national and international standards for fracture toughness determination.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, specific elements of fracture mechanics
Linear-elastic fracture mechanics. Griffith's theory. Westergaard's solution. Irwin's approximation. Definition of the stress intensity factor
Stress intensity factor for bodies with different types of cracks
Aspects regarding finite element modeling of bodies with cracks. Realization of crack tip singularity. Methods for estimating fracture mechanics parameters
Experimental methods for determining the stress intensity factor
Experimental determination of fracture toughness. Factors influencing fracture toughness
Aspects of elasto-plastic fracture mechanics. Size of the plastic zone formed at the crack tip. Crack tip opening displacement. J-integral
Analytical calculation of fracture mechanics parameters in the linear-elastic domain
Calculation of crack propagation rate and durability of resistance elements
Experimental determination of fracture toughness. KIC method
Determination by photoelasticimetry of the stress intensity factor at a crack tip
Determination of crack propagation rate under variable loads
Determination of fracture mechanics parameters by the Finite Element Method
Estimation of durability for resistance elements based on fracture mechanics principles

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (2 theory topics and 1 application)
Short project (finite element method determination of stress intensity factors during laboratory hours)

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a written exam (67%) and a short project completed during laboratory hours (33%). To pass, students must demonstrate knowledge of linear elastic and elasto-plastic fracture mechanics parameters, master and apply criteria for fractured parts, and perform numerical simulations to determine fracture mechanics parameters.
